notes: Summary: enterprise ecommerce platform evaluating Redwood for catalog embeddings + chat support; ended up choosing self-host stack (vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM) citing cost and governance.
Early discovery (Sep 2025): Rina asked for 99th pct latency SLOs for 512-token chat; also needs prefix caching for product queries.
POC (Jan 2026): 2-week Dedicated trial. Perf looked good at target throughput but CFO flagged recurring hosted spend vs one-time infra capex.
Security review (Feb 2026): Legal and InfoSec demanded KMS integration, audit logs with 7-year retention, and ability to run in EU-only air-gapped environment. Raised risk to hosted model.
Quote from CTO: 'We need absolute control over model weights and KV cache — we'll operate vLLM on our DGX fleet; cost delta is significant at our scale.'
Negotiation: tried hybrid offer (private + burst to hosted) but procurement returned with internal decision to self-host and optimize w/ TensorRT-LLM for low-latency rerank path.
Reason lost: combination of budget direction (capex preference), security constraints (on-prem + data residency), and lack of single champion to sponsor Hosted contract.
Follow-up plan: keep monthly cadence for platform updates, offer migration playbook + partner list if they want to re-evaluate managed options later.
Internal ask: capture Infra/Optimize learnings — pricing sensitivity at large throughput customers; highlight need for stronger hybrid option with clearer one-time migration credits.
Staging: mark as closed-lost in CRM, set re-engage reminder 2026-09.
Attachments: drive deck + security faq shared during evaluation (see linked_drive_docs).
